baseline.visual: Final Viewer NOT PASS; observed low-contrast s_B = 0.000 and sparse layouts

research_question: Can runtime Manim object/glyph bounds + actual decoded H264 pixels catch defects source envelopes cannot, without falsifying all-frame claims?
scope: V3-54 host-synthetic creative SceneGraph renderer only; new instrumented versioned outputs never overwrite original MP4s

planned_hooks.compiler: Host-controlled instrumentation injected after V3-51 compiler object declarations, before Manim animation loop; observer logs actual world pixel bounds, visible glyph/shape state and 15fps frame timestamps inside Docker Manim
planned_hooks.provenance: All telemetry saved in /output:rw Docker mount; capture exact raw render SHA and media frame count; reject missing, corrupt, partial or counterfeited telemetry
planned_hooks.native: Render new narrated H264/AAC via unchanged bounded creative scene compiler; decode native pixel regions for contrast/text visibility and glyph/shape occlusion; geometry telemetry cannot alone claim actual pixel segmentation

hard_acceptance.frame_coverage: Per-frame runtime source telemetry exact or conservatively aligned with native frames; if mismatch, NO-GO not PASS
negative_tests: visible glyph intersect unrelated background bar
low text contrast on dark background
actual native pixel region not visible
hard_acceptance.outcomes: PASS_BOUNDED only with full runtime/pixel receipts; otherwise explicit NO_GO with root cause and concrete next step

non_goals: qualitative pedagogy quality, layout design taste
